description: This file defines a React functional component 'Navbar' for rendering the navigation bar of a web application. It manages navigation links, user authentication state display, and logout functionality, tailored for a Next.js project.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar, adjusting its display depending on authentication status.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function to handle user logout by calling API and redirecting to home.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Function to determine if a link is currently active based on the current path.
